display.purpose: Page-level hero headlines only. Never inside components.

headline.purpose: Section headings and major UI titles. One per section.

title.purpose: Component headings, card titles, modal titles.

body.purpose: All prose and descriptions. Max 65ch line length.

label.purpose: Monospace kickers, metadata, timestamps, data values. Uppercase, tracked.

shadows.name: structural-float
shadows.purpose: Physically separates floating elements (hero mock, modals, popovers) from the page. Not used for hover states or ambient glow.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Default easing for all reveal and state transitions. Spring-like feel without bounce.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Short interactions: hover color changes, border transitions. 150-300ms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: @media (prefers-reduced-motion): crossfade or instant; never skip the transition entirely.

components.description: The single primary CTA per view. Precision Mint background, black text. Rare — one per screen region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 28px; background: #00FFAA; color: #000; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00E599; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Ghost Button

narrative.overview:
Commit's visual language is built on restraint and precision. The surface is near-void — dark enough that the UI disappears, leaving only the data. Generous negative space acts as structure; the borders and dividers are the grid. Nothing is decorative. Every component earns its presence by carrying signal the user needs right now.

The mint accent (#00FFAA) is not a brand color in the conventional sense. It is a measurement instrument. It marks what is live, what is active, what has been completed. Its rarity on any given screen is precisely what makes it meaningful.

This system explicitly rejects curriculum-driven UI, gamification chrome, and generic dark SaaS aesthetics.
keyCharacteristics: Near-void dark ground with tonal layering
Mint accent used sparingly: active state, completion, key measurements only
Monospace for all data, metrics, labels, and timestamps
Typography hierarchy built on weight and size contrast, not color
Borders as structural dividers, not decoration

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Precision Mint at full opacity is permitted only when it carries active or completion state, a live measurement, or the single primary CTA per view.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is expressed through the three surface levels (bg-base, bg-surface, bg-elevated). No box shadows. No blur layers. No glassmorphism.

rules.name: The No Ambient Shadow Rule
rules.body: Box shadows are prohibited except to physically separate a floating element from the page. No ambient glow under buttons.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk for meaning; JetBrains Mono for measurement. Never swap them.

rules.name: The Label Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Monospace uppercase labels are permitted once per section as orientation. A kicker on every card is noise, not system.

dos: Use JetBrains Mono for all numerical data, timestamps, session metadata, and status labels
Let the Precision Mint accent touch ≤15% of any screen at full opacity
Express depth through tonal surface levels, never through shadows
Use text-wrap: balance on h1–h3 to prevent orphan lines
Write button labels as verb + object: 'Start for free', 'Delete session', 'Export PDF'
Show empty states as instructive — explain what the component will show once populated
Apply reduced-motion alternatives to every animation
donts: Don't build curriculum UI: no lesson trees, no 'complete this module' paths, no XP bars
Don't gamify: no streak-as-product toasts, no mascots, no celebration animations for routine actions
Don't use purple or blue gradients, neon glows, or glassmorphism as decoration
Don't put a monospace uppercase kicker on every section and every card
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe
Don't add shadows to buttons, card hover states, or section backgrounds
Don't use the accent color as a brand wash or background fill
